text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* I gave it everything I had!
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The pace was a bit too fast...
Did my excitement get the better of me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well, we can reflect on that later.
Right now, more importantly—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you so much—!!

Narita Top Road waves energetically
to the people who cheered for her. Her figure was――
She seemed like an honor student, and at the same time, a model role model who truly cared for the racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much!
Thanks to you, I was able to debut without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And so, right away—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Please.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
First, the areas for improvement.
I wanted to take notes before I forget.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: There are areas for improvement, right?

I list the things I noticed from watching.
"Lacked a bit of composure."
"Cornering was awkward."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hmm, and then...
(――*sploosh!*)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There's blood on the floor... She might
have cut her leg somewhere.

When I quickly checked, sure enough,
she had heavily scraped the thigh area of her leg.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, I didn't feel any pain at all,
so I had no idea I was injured...
choice_data_list: Are you still not feeling any pain?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's gradually starting to hurt.
I wonder why, ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Could it be that I'm just dense?
choice_data_list: No, I'm sure it was just because you were so focused.
No, it must be because you were so focused.

text_block_list.text: She is so earnest at heart that she didn't seem to notice while completely focused on running.
This concentration seems like a strength, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Thank you very much
for the training today!
choice_data_list: We went pretty hard at the end there— are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm totally fine!
I won't improve unless I push myself this much.
(――*sploosh!*)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Huh? It's bleeding again...
That's strange, maybe I pushed myself too hard.

The injury itself didn't seem serious.
She had just gotten a scrape from training too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like I can't run.
No problem at all!
However, not noticing it at all, and not even trying to care, is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go get it treated lightly in the infirmary later.
Just to be safe with my shoulder too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. It popped out earlier,
so I put it back in place myself."
choice_data_list: You popped it back in... your shoulder joint!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It comes off every now and then.
Because I swing my arms with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't let something like that
interrupt our crucial training!"
I felt a faint sense of alarm. Being diligent was good, but she was taking it way too far...
This utterly straightforward and pure heart would eventually—

Wouldn't this gradually wear down her body?
I just couldn't shake that concern away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could we please have a meeting
soon regarding our next race?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Which race should we aim for?
A graded race this autumn, perhaps? Or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Taking a bold step and aiming for a GⅠ might
be a good idea too. If that's what you expect of me—

Our feelings are one and the same. Two hearts beating as one toward a shared dream.
That will never change. But...
choice_data_list: Let's not set a fixed goal and just take our time gaining experience.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, taking it slow...?
Are we not deciding on a destination?
choice_data_list: Yeah, taking care of your body comes first.
Yeah, taking care of your body comes first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Take good care of my body, right?
Understood...!
From the way she spoke earlier, it sounds like she does want to aim for graded and GⅠ races, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Of course I yearn for the big races.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If that's the plan you decided on, Trainer,
then I believe in it too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We are completely united as one!
Please instruct us however you see fit, Trainer!"

Narita Top Road gladly agreed.
This earnest honesty of hers was also one of her greatest strengths.
I should focus on being the voice of reason here, protecting her while helping her gain race experience.
